title: Historical Hijra
paragraphs: Ketika tekanan di Makkah sudah menjadi terlalu berbahaya, Nabi ﷺ sedang bersiap untuk hijrah ke Madinah, perjalanan yang direncanakan dengan hati-hati secara rahasia selama beberapa minggu yang penuh ketegangan. Saat musuh-musuhnya sedang merencanakan untuk menghentikannya, Abu Bakar sudah lebih dulu mengatur perbekalan dan seorang penunjuk jalan yang mengetahui rute gurun tersembunyi yang belum pernah dipakai kebanyakan musafir.

Selama perjalanan, mereka bersembunyi di dalam sebuah gua selama tiga hari sementara regu pencari sedang melintas di dekatnya, tidak menyadari bahwa dua musafir yang mereka cari sedang bersembunyi hanya beberapa meter jauhnya. Setelah akhirnya mereka tiba dengan selamat di Madinah, komunitas di sana sudah bersiap menyambut selama berminggu-minggu, karena telah mendengar bahwa Nabi ﷺ sedang dalam perjalanan menuju mereka.
answerKey: When the pressure in Makkah had grown too dangerous, the Prophet ﷺ was preparing to migrate to Madinah, a journey that was carefully planned in secret over several tense weeks. While his enemies were plotting to stop him, Abu Bakr had already been arranging supplies and a guide who knew hidden desert routes that most travelers had never used before. During the journey, they were hiding inside a cave for three days while search parties were passing nearby, unaware that the two travelers they were looking for were hiding just meters away. Once they finally reached Madinah safely, the community there had already been preparing a warm welcome for weeks, having heard that the Prophet ﷺ was making his way toward them.
